(I)--(मार्ग) taught by नारद to the children of दक्ष;
1: भा.

(II)--(see also Yati) main व्रतस् five; and sup- plementary, five; main:--ध्यानम्, समाधि of the senses, begging at seven houses, silence and release from sangha. Supplementary:--Purity in conduct, discipline (vinaya) शौचम्, non-retaliation and सम्यक्दर्शनम्, besides non theft, Brahmacarya, non-covetousness, ahimsa, non-anger, service to the Guru, medicated food, daily study, alms, resig [page२-561+ २९] nation, generosity, etc., becomes one with ब्रह्मा for observing such dharma. Br.
